detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Game Overview

On a midsummer morning, Miki wakes up in a park, surrounded by countless cups of iced coffee—still ice-cold, yet untouched.

She has no idea why she is there, nor does she understand what the approaching shadows are. There is only one thing she knows for sure:

Drinking iced coffee lets her catch her breath—just a little longer.

Run, breathe, run again… This is a jungle chase filled with the unknown and an overwhelming sense of pressure.

Can Miki evade the men in black and make it home safely before time runs out?

Game Features

This is an small escape simulation game.

Players will experience intense chase sequences and do their best to escape from relentless pursuers.

Gameplay

  • The game features 3 stages, each lasting around 3 minutes

  • The number of enemies increases with each stage

  • Players must avoid pursuit within a limited time and drink iced coffee to restore stamina
